event_text: World War I: U-boat campaign: Two days after the United Kingdom had declared war on Germany over the German invasion of Belgium, ten German U-boats leave their base in Heligoland to attack Royal Navy warships in the North Sea.
headline: Germany Launches Surprise U-Boat Attack on Royal Navy
story: Barry gazed out at the North Sea, where the German U-boats were lurking. 'Ten of them, Susan, slipped out of Heligoland two days after the UK declared war. The Germans are taking a bit of a punt, hoping to catch the Royal Navy off guard.' Susan cocked her head, 'And the British, blissfully unaware, are still thinking this is going to be a nice, tidy war, aren't they? No idea the Germans have just sent a bunch of subs to ruin their day.' Barry snorted, 'The U-boats are armed with torpedoes, and the Royal Navy's got...well, they've got a lot of big ships, but not a lot of anti-submarine gear. This could get interesting.' Susan murmured, 'The Germans are trying to even the odds, I suppose. They can't take on the Royal Navy in a straight fight, but they might just be able to pick off a few ships with these newfangled U-boats.' Barry watched as the U-boats began their attack, 'And so, the war at sea begins. Should be a lovely mess.'
regret_line: A bit of a shame they didn't just stick to the whole "not invading Belgium" thing.
winner_line: The arms manufacturers, who must have been rubbing their hands together at the prospect of a long, bloody war.
